h0: Promotion does not change demand distributions
assumptions: Independent observations; ordinal/rank test; distributions need not be normal
sample_definition: All observed rows with valid demand
limitations: Association is statistically assessed; confounding by product, store, timing remains

h0: Demand distributions are equal across store types
h1: At least one store type differs
assumptions: Independent groups; rank-based test; similar distribution shape is desirable
sample_definition: All observed rows grouped by store_type
limitations: A significant result identifies a difference, not its cause

h0: Promotion and stock-out status are independent
assumptions: Expected cell counts should be adequate; rows independent
limitations: Stock-out observations may be affected by assortment and missing inventory coverage
